exposure: Current practices regarding antenatal iron supplementation
outcome: Women's knowledge and identified gaps regarding iron in pregnancy
Reported difficulties with oral supplementation (cost, tolerance, side-effects)
Perception of iron infusions (simplicity, effectiveness, safety)
Documentation of antenatal iron supplementation advice
cohort: The study included 206 pregnant women attending antenatal services in early pregnancy in South Australia.
finding: The study found variable knowledge among women regarding iron in pregnancy, significant difficulties with oral supplementation, a positive perception of iron infusions, and that midwives were not consistently informing women or supporting them on dietary modifications and oral supplementation.
